cover.title: Participatory Urban Design/Placemaking Survey
cover.subtitle: Placemaking Trends Survey 2026/2027
body: We are inviting city officials and municipal planning professionals worldwide to share their experience with citizen engagement in public space development. Your answers will help to shape our upcoming Placemaking Trends 2026–2027 Report.
It takes about 5 minutes. All responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate. At the end you can opt in to receive the report, or to test an early version of our digital toolkit.

steps.optionalHint: Optional — you can continue without answering.
steps.newLineHint: Shift + Enter adds a new line

module1.label: Which best describes your primary role?
How long have you served in municipal planning/engagement?
How is civic participation integrated into your municipality's strategy and budget?

options.label: High strategic priority with dedicated budget
High priority, but budget/resources are limited

module2.label: How do you currently deliver public engagement processes?
Which tool types do you regularly rely on?

options.label: Spatial & GIS Platforms (e.g., Maptionnaire, Felt, ArcGIS)
Standard Survey Tools (e.g., Typeform, SurveyMonkey, Google Forms)
Social Media & Messaging Channels (e.g., Facebook, WhatsApp)

module2.label: How well do your current digital tools serve non-technical citizens?

module3.label: What are your top 3 friction points in placemaking and civic design? (Select up to 3)

options.label: Structuring qualitative citizen feedback into usable GIS data
Maintaining resident momentum over long timelines
Convincing council / leadership with actionable reports
High software costs or lack of technical budget

module3.label: How difficult is it to convert qualitative feedback into actionable design steps?

module4.label: How valuable would Interactive Spatial Filtering be to your department? Enabling citizens and staff to add, remove and filter design ideas on a live map.
How valuable would a Global Case Study Hub be to your department? A searchable, peer-to-peer repository of community-driven placemaking projects.
How valuable would a Publishing Network be to your department? The ability to benchmark and share your local municipal projects with international peers.
Anything you would like to add?

optIns.label: Send me a copy of the Placemaking Trends 2026/2027 Report once it is ready
Sign up for early beta access and product testing

success.title: Thank You!
success.body: Your answers are in. If you asked for the report, beta access or a demonstration, we will be in touch at the address you left.
